# Whye.org

> > Whye.org explores economics, finance, and policy through in-depth analysis of trade wars, technological unemployment, behavioral economics, and accounting principles.

The site examines contemporary economic issues including US-China trade tensions, automation's impact on labor markets, economic rent theory, and financial regulation. Content spans international trade policy, behavioral finance, infrastructure development, and professional accounting standards.

## Key Topics

- Technological unemployment
- Economic rent and rent-seeking
- US-China trade relations
- Behavioral economics and finance
- Economic corridors and infrastructure
- Global supply chains
- Laffer Curve and tax policy
- Special Economic Zones (SEZs)
- Automation and job displacement
- Public-private partnerships
- Financial reporting standards (GAAP/IFRS)
- Environmental economics
- Trade policy and tariffs
- Natural resource management
- Workforce retraining

## International Trade & Tariffs

- [Trade War Effects on Agriculture Exports](https://whye.org/trade-war-effects-on-agriculture-exports): Analyzes US-China trade war impacts on American farmers & ag exports
- [Impact of US–China Tariffs on Technology Industry](https://whye.org/impact-of-us-china-tariffs-on-technology-industry): Examines US-China tariffs' effects on tech supply chains & semiconductors
- [Steel and Aluminum Tariffs During the Trade War](https://whye.org/steel-and-aluminum-tariffs-during-the-trade-war): Analyzes Section 232 steel/aluminum tariffs under Trump administration

## Technological Unemployment & Labor Markets

- [Are there examples of successful strategies for managing technological unemployment at the community level?](https://whye.org/are-there-examples-of-successful-strategies-for-managing-technological-unemployment-at-the-community-level): Reviews community-level strategies like Code Louisville for tech unemployment
- [How does globalization impact technological unemployment?](https://whye.org/how-does-globalization-impact-technological-unemployment): Examines globalization's effects on automation & job displacement trends
- [Can technological unemployment lead to shifts in the overall job market structure?](https://whye.org/can-technological-unemployment-lead-to-shifts-in-the-overall-job-market-structure): Investigates automation's impact on job market structure & gig economy
- [Is retraining and education an effective solution to mitigate technological unemployment?](https://whye.org/is-retraining-and-education-an-effective-solution-to-mitigate-technological-unemployment): Evaluates retraining programs' effectiveness against tech unemployment

## Behavioral Economics & Finance

- [What are the key principles of behavioral finance?](https://whye.org/what-are-the-key-principles-of-behavioral-finance): Covers behavioral finance principles including Kahneman's Prospect Theory
- [What are some famous Ponzi Scheme examples in history?](https://whye.org/what-are-some-famous-ponzi-scheme-examples-in-history): Reviews infamous Ponzi schemes including Madoff & Stanford cases
- [How does speculation in financial markets contribute to economic rent?](https://whye.org/how-does-speculation-in-financial-markets-contribute-to-economic-rent): Examines financial speculation's contribution to economic rent generation

## Accounting & Financial Reporting

- [Why Accountants Prefer Accrual Accounting Over Cash Method](https://whye.org/why-accountants-prefer-accrual-accounting-over-cash-method): Explains accrual accounting superiority under GAAP & IFRS standards
- [Key Responsibilities of a Professional Accountant](https://whye.org/key-responsibilities-of-a-professional-accountant): Details core accountant duties from financial reporting to compliance

## Economic Theory & Policy

- [How does the concept of economic rent intersect with environmental economics?](https://whye.org/how-does-the-concept-of-economic-rent-intersect-with-environmental-economics): Explores economic rent's role in environmental economics & resource mgmt
- [How does economic rent contribute to the concept of economic rent-seeking?](https://whye.org/how-does-economic-rent-contribute-to-the-concept-of-economic-rent-seeking): Explores economic rent dynamics & rent-seeking behavior in markets
- [How does the Laffer Curve account for externalities and non-market factors influencing economic behavior?](https://whye.org/how-does-the-laffer-curve-account-for-externalities-and-non-market-factors-influencing-economic-behavior): Explores Laffer Curve analysis with externalities & behavioral factors
- [How does GDP account for changes in population size?](https://whye.org/how-does-gdp-account-for-changes-in-population-size): Explains GDP per capita's role in measuring economic growth per person
- [What is the role of gender in economic sociology, and how does it impact economic outcomes?](https://whye.org/what-is-the-role-of-gender-in-economic-sociology-and-how-does-it-impact-economic-outcomes): Explores gender's role in economic sociology & wage inequality impacts

## Infrastructure & Economic Development

- [How do economic corridors impact job creation and employment opportunities?](https://whye.org/how-do-economic-corridors-impact-job-creation-and-employment-opportunities): Analyzes economic corridors' impact on job creation & workforce development
- [How do governments and private sectors collaborate in the development of economic corridors?](https://whye.org/how-do-governments-and-private-sectors-collaborate-in-the-development-of-economic-corridors): Explores PPP models & BOT frameworks in economic corridor development
